_ghi_chu: Hội thoại dạng cây (GDD Phụ lục). Node: speaker (vai trong characters.json, 'player', 'narrator'), text {en}, anim (nod|wave|think|point — NPC đang nói diễn 1 lần rồi nói tiếp), effects, next; hoặc choices [{text, effects, next}] (phím 1–4 hoặc click); hoặc branch [{if:{flags,not_flags,quests,rewards}, next}] + next mặc định; hoặc action 'minigame:<id>' rồi next. style: 'phone' = tin nhắn trên điện thoại (vd HR). Chữ thay thế: {player} = tên người chơi, {missing} = việc còn thiếu. draft: true = chờ HR → game hiện [DRAFT].

text.en: Good morning, {player}! It's Nga from Recruitment. Your shuttle today is Bus No. 2 to Hòa Lạc — pickup at 06:45 at this stop. Your intern code for the My FPT app: FV-2026. See you at F-Ville!
Find Bus No. 2 before 06:45.
A big amber "1" glows on the windshield. Your message said Bus No. 2.
A big amber "2" on the windshield — this is the bus to Hòa Lạc!
A big amber "3" glows on the windshield. Your message said Bus No. 2.
Morning! Looking for your bus?
Is this the bus to Hòa Lạc?
(Just looking around.)
Hòa Lạc? Not this one — that's Bus No. 2, right behind me. Can't miss it!
Have a good one!
Morning! Looking for your bus?
Is this the bus to Hòa Lạc?
(Just looking around.)
Hòa Lạc? Not this one — that's Bus No. 2, just up ahead past the shelter.
Have a good one!
Are you an intern in this batch too? I'm Tú. I'm so nervous... I don't even know where to go after we get off the bus.
Me too — let's stick together!
I'm sure someone will show us around.
Really? Phew, I feel so much better already!
Yeah... I guess you're right.
We're on Bus No. 2, right? Let's go find it!
Two new interns? Welcome aboard! I'm Huyền — I'm picking up your batch today.
A new intern? Welcome aboard! I'm Huyền — I'm picking up your batch today.
This is Bus No. 2, straight to Hòa Lạc. Ask me anything before we go!
What would you like to know?
What time does the bus head back?
Are there any rules on the company bus?
Have you been riding this route long?
That's all — thank you!
The buses head back to the city in the evening — HR will put the exact times in your app.
Be at the stop a few minutes early, keep your seatbelt on, and keep the bus clean. Easy!
Six years now! Little secret: the window seats near the back have the best view of the rice fields on the way in.
Great! Hop on whenever you're ready — Bus No. 2 leaves at 06:45 sharp.
Hop on, we're leaving soon!
Oh — are you getting on too? Sorry, this bag is a bit heavy...
After you! Take your time.
(Squeeze past and get on first.)
Thank you, that's very kind!
Oh... okay then.
Wait — shouldn't we say hi to the lady at the door first? She looks like she's from FPT.
Hi there! Are you one of the new interns? Come say hello first!
Hi! I'm Tú — first day too. Mind if I sit here?
Window seat, yes! Hòa Lạc, here we come.
Tú drops {tu_his} backpack on the seat beside {tu_him} and stares out the window.
Here we are, {player}! First things first: let's get the My FPT app on your phone.
It holds your checklist for today, your items and the badges you'll earn.
Let's install it!
Badges? What kind of badges?
You'll find out at the Cuder Statue. Some of them you earn just by being nice to people.
Okay, phone out!
Three steps, in this order: download My FPT, log in with the intern code from Ms. Nga's message, then turn on notifications.
All set! Head straight to the gate. I'll go up to the office first — message me in the app if you need anything.
Go on through the gate. See you upstairs!
{player}, wait! Install the My FPT app first.
Mind your step. First day, huh?
Yes! Thank you so much — drive safely!
(Nod and hop off.)
Ha, a polite one! Have a great first day.
Off you go, then.
Go get 'em, kid!
F-Ville shuttle buses run between Hà Nội and Hòa Lạc. Morning buses arrive at 07:30.
Return buses leave at 17:30 and 18:15. The times are saved to your app.
Our first photo at F-Ville! Pick a pose, then take the shot — and yes, I'm jumping in too.
A real village well! Pull the rope the moment the marker is in the green zone. Three buckets — each one comes with a little story.
There's a story about the statue here. Let's read it first, then answer three questions. A wrong answer just gets a hint — no stress!
These cards are FPT milestones. Let's put them in order — oldest at the top — then press Check.
You hold your new employee card to the reader. Beep — green light! The glass doors swing open.
Excuse me! Could I come in with you? I left my card on the bus.
Sure, come on in.
Sorry, I can't let you in — reception can help you.
Thanks, you're a lifesaver!
He slips through the gate behind you and hurries towards the stairs.
Hi {player}! A quick tip from me: at the card gate, everyone taps their own card — even someone who seems friendly. Reception can always help guests get in. 🙂
Fair enough — rules are rules. I'll ask at reception. Thanks!
He heads back down the corridor towards the lobby.
Tú taps {tu_his} card. Beep — the light flashes red.
Huh? My card's red... Could you just let me follow you through?
Sure, come with me.
I'll message Ms. Nga in the app.
Maybe ask at reception?
Thanks, {player}! Phew.
{player}, I saw Tú come in on your card. 🙂 Even friends shouldn't follow each other through the gate — if a card doesn't work, message Ms. Nga in the app and she'll sort it out.
You open My FPT and message Ms. Nga: "Tú's card shows red at the gate — could you help?"
Got it! I've just activated Tú's card — try again now. Thanks for looking out for each other!
Tú taps again. Beep — green!
It works! Thanks, {player} — you always know who to ask.
Okay... I'll go and ask. You go on ahead — I'll catch up!

return_line.en: I'm back! Reception sorted my card out.

text.en: A sign by the glass door reads: "FSA — FPT Software Academy. Learning never stops here: every FSofter has a learning path, from first-week courses to certificates."
Let's plan our first week! Put the three suggested courses on the calendar — basics first, then the ones that build on them.
Below it, a screen invites you to plan your first week: put the three suggested courses on the calendar — basics first, then the ones that build on them.
My team's on the floor above. See you after work, okay?
Tú waves and heads back to the stairs.
Reception fixed my card! My team's on the floor above, so I'm heading straight up. See you after work, okay?
Wait — before we go in, let's plan our first week at the FSA board!
Before you go in, plan your first week at the FSA board by the door.
Hold on, we're not done here yet: {missing}.
Let's finish up here first: {missing}.
{player}? Welcome to F-Ville! I'm Nga from Recruitment — so nice to finally meet you in person.
After all our emails and calls, it's lovely to put a face to the name. Did my message get you onto Bus No. 2 all right?
Yes — Ms. Huyền was waiting right at the door!
Just in time — I almost got on Bus No. 1!
That's Huyền — she never loses an intern. Oh, and look: orange suits you. We match today!
Ha! The number on the windshield is the one to trust. Anyway, you made it — and orange suits you. We match today!
Now, the paperwork. One detail on this form got mixed up — can you find that line, then pick the right value for it?
Perfect. Now a quick photo for your card: pick an expression, then take the shot. Big smile — you'll be wearing this one every day!
Here's your FPT employee card, {player}, and your Welcome Kit. From our first call to your first day — I'm so glad you're here!
Your card opens the gates upstairs. If anything comes up today, just message me in the app!
Excuse me — I found this wallet on the seats over there.
Oh, thank you! Someone must be worried sick. I'll make sure it gets back to its owner.
And you must be {player}! I'm Nga from Recruitment — so nice to finally meet you in person.
Someone left a wallet on the seat.
Take it to the reception desk.
Leave it where it is.
You picked up the wallet. The reception desk is just over there.
Wait... where's my backpack?!
I think I left it on the bus! Could you help me look? The bus hasn't left yet.
Sure — I'll check the bus!
Don't worry, we'll find it.
A glass jar of golden grains. You've found {grains} of {grains_total} — more are hidden around F-Ville.
My backpack! You're a lifesaver, {player}!
📅 09:15 · Meeting with Prajith — Mentor meeting room, on the left side of the office.
Hi {player}, welcome to the office! I'm Prajith, your mentor. I'm in the meeting room on the left — the door's open. See you in a minute! 🙂
There you are, {player}! Welcome to the team. I'm Prajith — I'll be your mentor during your internship.
I still remember my own first day here: I spent the morning learning everyone's names, and the afternoon finding the best coffee on this floor. You'll have both sorted by Friday!
Before we plan anything, I'd like to know how you like to work. Four quick questions — there are no right or wrong answers.
Thanks, {player} — that tells me a lot. Your Career Compass is saved in My FPT. Let's look at it together again at the end of your first month.
Next, the manager would like to meet you. Her room is next door — just a little further down.
The manager's room is just next door. And I'm right here all day if you have any questions!
Hi there — you must be our new intern! Have a chat with Prajith first; he's in the meeting room next door. I'll be right here.
Hi {player}, welcome to the team! I'm really glad you're here.
Our team builds and looks after software for customers around the world. This quarter our goal is simple: ship reliable releases, and help each other learn along the way.
Your first week doesn't need anything big. But I'd like to see how you'd organise your work.
Here are five tasks for your first week. Put them in order — the most urgent at the top, the one that can wait at the bottom — then press Check.
That's exactly how I'd do it: what's due today first, the nice-to-haves last. Very wise!
Good effort! Just remember: anything due today comes first, and the extras can wait until you've settled in.
I've added your first mission to My FPT: finish the mandatory information security course today. Then set up your laptop at your desk.
Oh — it's almost noon! The whole team is heading out for lunch. Come with us!

card.en: 12:00 · The team invites you to lunch

text.en: Your desk is the one near the entrance, with Lan and Minh right beside it. Settle in, and say hello to everyone!
Hi! You must be {player} — I'm Lan. We sit in the same cluster, so you'll see a lot of me!
My first-day tip: don't be afraid to ask questions. Everyone here was new once — and we all remember how it felt.
If you need anything, just lean over — I'm right here!
Hey {player}, welcome aboard! I'm Minh — two years on this team and still loving it.
My tip: write things down. New names, tools, where things live — your notes from this week will save you hours next month.
Ask me anything about our tools — I love that stuff.
Hi, I'm Hà! Welcome to the team, {player}.
My tip: keep your calendar open and turn on reminders. Meetings move around a lot, and it's easy to miss one in your first week.
Good luck today — you're doing great!
Hey, a new face! I'm Khang. Taking a little break?
Fancy a single shot of billiards? Aim, pick your power, and try to sink the orange ball.
Sure, one shot!
Maybe later.
In the pocket! You're a natural.
So close! Honestly, trying is half the fun.
Here's my tip: take real breaks. Step away from the screen for a few minutes — good ideas often turn up over a game of billiards.
The table's free — want another shot?
Sure!
Not now, thanks.
Great shot!
Almost! The table will be here tomorrow too.
A tidy desk with a laptop, a blank name plate and a gift box with an orange ribbon. Meet the manager first — she'll tell you where to start.
Your teammates Lan, Minh and Hà sit just around the corner. Say hello before you settle in?
I'll say hello first.
Sit down now.
Your desk! A laptop, a blank name plate — and a gift box with an orange ribbon.
Inside the box: an FPT notebook, a water bottle and a card — "Welcome to the team, {player}! — Lan, Minh, Hà, Khang & everyone".
Time to log in for the first time: create a strong password, then turn on two-factor authentication.
The name plate on your desk now reads: {player} · Intern.
Your first-day checklist pops up in My FPT…
You settle in and get to work. The afternoon flies by…
Your desk, with your name on it. See you here tomorrow!
⏰ 17:30 — that's a wrap for today! Time to head home.
17:30 already! Time to head home, {player} — see you tomorrow!
See you tomorrow, Lan!
{player}! Without you today I'd have been totally lost. Thanks for everything!
{player}! The first day wasn't that scary after all, was it? See you tomorrow!
Our bus is here — let's go home!
